mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing chest was most worthwhile because the final picture tied ventilation, circulation and oxygen delivery together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the completed exchange surface into its named slot was predictable, though it was a clear step in the construction.

surprise.text: The shrinking oxygen arrows showed why blood flow alone cannot sustain exchange when the air is not renewed.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and named slot gave the combinations clear purposes.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions connected familiar body parts to mechanisms such as gas exchange and breathing in a way I found interesting.
